sentences.en: How are you doing in this scorching late summer heat?
sentences.zh: 你在这个酷热的盛夏还好吗？

sentences.en: She put up an umbrella against a scorching sun.
sentences.zh: 她撑起一把伞来抵挡那刺眼的烈日。

sentences.en: Apparently it's going to be scorching from Friday on.
sentences.zh: 显然从星期五开始就会非常炎热了。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：scorch（烧焦）+ing（…的）→能烧焦的→酷热的
